claims.quote: Protocadherin 19 (PCDH19) gene is one of the most common genes involved in epilepsy syndromes.
According to literature data PCDH19 is among the 6 genes most involved in genetic epilepsies.
PCDH19 is located on chromosome Xq22.1
is involved in neuronal connections and signal transduction.

claims.object_text: epilepsy and mental retardation limited to female (EFMR)
claims.quote: The most frequent clinical expression of PCDH19 mutation is epilepsy and mental retardation limited to female (EFMR)
The peculiar exclusive involvement of females seems to be caused by a cellular interference in heterozygosity

claims.object_text: focal seizure to generalized tonic-clonic, tonic, atonic, absences, and myoclonic jerks
claims.quote: Seizure types range from focal seizure to generalized tonic-clonic, tonic, atonic, absences, and myoclonic jerks.

claims.object_text: from genetic epilepsy with febrile seizure plus to epileptic encephalopathies
claims.quote: The phenotypic spectrum of these mutations is considerably variable from genetic epilepsy with febrile seizure plus to epileptic encephalopathies.

claims.object_text: limited by drug resistance and by the absence of specific treatment indications
claims.quote: Treatment of PCDH19-related epilepsy is limited by drug resistance and by the absence of specific treatment indications.

claims.object_text: seizures become less severe with adolescence and some patients may even become seizure-free

claims.object_text: Non-epileptic symptoms represent the main disabilities of adult patients with PCDH19 mutation
